scenario_description:
Objective: Make the Mankato campus arrival smoother while the appointment and ordinary visitor check-in remain unchanged.
Emerging Need: An optional pre-cleared North Gate badge is unusable until the arrival gate is known and the visitor-services queue opens.
Decision Context: The useful choice depends on joining the gate-specific alert with stored pre-clearance instructions and the active visitor access confirmation, rather than on the calendar alone.
Consequence: Acting within the queue would reduce arrival friction; missing the cutoff simply leaves the standard walk-up badge desk in place.
